description: This Java source file defines a class 'DateTimeConverters' containing multiple nested classes that implement various data type conversions related to date and time, such as converting between Calendar, Date, String, SQL Date/Time/Timestamp, and Duration objects. It includes methods for parsing, formatting, and converting date/time objects, and is part of the 'org.apache.ofbiz.base.conversion' package.
